data.value: Date and Time Functions: 1. DateTime.Now.ToString(): - Converts date/time elements to string format. - Syntax: DateTime.Now.ToString("hh:mm tt dddd, dd MMMM yyyy") 2. DatePart(): - Extracts a specific part of a date (e.g., week of year). - Syntax: DatePart(DateInterval.WeekOfYear, Now) 3. DateDiff(): - Calculates the difference between two date values. - Syntax: DateDiff(DateInterval.Month, date1, date2)
